svg.title: Figure 2 | Four parallel acceptance scenarios
svg.desc: A–D test different conditions without a required order. Within D, changed data invalidates the old validation result.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: All three fields have valid values. The user checks the form.
Completeness passes, and preview and export use the same record.
Scenario B: a required field is missing
Document type is empty. Identify the omission, prevent export of a
report marked complete and retain entered data.
Applicant code contains three spaces. It is not necessarily an
empty string, but trimming leaves no valid content, so treat it as
Scenario D: data changes after a pass
The user passes validation, then deletes document type. Invalidate
the old result immediately and prevent export using the stale
A–D test different conditions without a required order. Within D,
changed data invalidates the old validation result.
